Why brokers, not a platform?

Plenty of benefits schemes give people a portal and a list of numbers to call. Then it is up to them to work out who to speak to next.

Get Perks is built differently. We are brokers who do the work ourselves, not a platform that hands people on. When one of your people asks for help with their mortgage, protection, will or savings, an experienced broker picks it up and sees it through.

One point of contact. No being passed from provider to provider.
